title: Glowing toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glowing toothbrush -->
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='50' rx='6' fill='#33e0ff'/>
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='4' height='50' rx='2' fill='#8ff4ff'/>
  <rect x='52' y='42' width='4' height='50' rx='2' fill='#1aa8cc'/>
  <!-- grip stripes -->
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='12' height='5' fill='#ff5fc8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='12' height='5' fill='#ff5fc8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='12' height='5' fill='#ff5fc8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#33e0ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#8ff4ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='38' y='12' width='24' height='16' rx='7' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='38' y='12' width='24' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- bristles -->
  <rect x='40' y='6' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='4' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='52' y='4' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='58' y='6' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='3' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='50' r='2' fill='#aef7ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='58' r='3' fill='#aef7ff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='14' r='2' fill='#fff59d'/>
</svg>
